Messages.Author: Chris Hoffman
Messages.Body:
I've got too many questions but... here goes.

MERRILL MOLITOR text reads:

"Once each combat, Merrill may change 1 damage from aggravated to normal"

Does this mean that Merrill can change all aggravated damage from one
strike? Or does it mean that Merrill can change one point of aggravated
damage from a strike?

THEFT OF VITAE

Can theft of Vitae be used to steal life from retainers and allies?

WASSERSCHLOSS ANIF, AUSTRIA

"During your master phase, you may move 1 blood from any Tremere you
control to this card. ..."

Can all (ie. more than one) controlled Tremere vampires move 1 blood to
this location?

--CHRIS--

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Chris Hoffman wrote:
>
> I've got too many questions but... here goes.
>
> MERRILL MOLITOR text reads:
>
> "Once each combat, Merrill may change 1 damage from aggravated to normal"
>
> Does this mean that Merrill can change all aggravated damage from one
> strike? Or does it mean that Merrill can change one point of aggravated
> damage from a strike?

He can change 1 point of aggravated damage to normal damage. The damage
doesn't have to be from a strike.

> THEFT OF VITAE
>
> Can theft of Vitae be used to steal life from retainers and allies?

Yes. (From retainers only if the round is at long range, since you
can't target retainers otherwise).

> WASSERSCHLOSS ANIF, AUSTRIA
>
> "During your master phase, you may move 1 blood from any Tremere you
> control to this card. ..."
>
> Can all (ie. more than one) controlled Tremere vampires move 1 blood to
> this location?

No, since more than one Tremere cannot share the same blood.
You can move 1 blood to Wass. That one blood can come from any
Tremere you control.
